purpose: Proposed named model and release-version coverage reconciled into the timeline data
date_policy: Dates reflect explicitly sourced public introduction/first access. Do not synthesize days from month-only evidence. null and YYYY-MM records are retained in catalog with verification=unverified; they should not be plotted at a fabricated first-of-month date. Stage-only/format-only changes stay in release_milestones.
coverage_policy: This is an audited named-family proposal, not universal completeness. Every vendor has an explicit audited/unresolved/excluded matrix. Single family rows where variants were not expanded are disclosed.
